The GitHub repository is a mirror: pull requests are reviewed here, applied to the main repository with your authorship kept, and closed with a note naming the commit. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cristobaltormo/git-sync/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings`, `cargo test`)
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, with a fake server where it talks to one
- [ ] A new or changed git server was tried against a real instance, or is marked experimental
- [ ] `docs/`, `README.md`, `README.es.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated where it applies
- [ ] No secrets in code, tests or logs
